blurb: Guests can take passenger flights in a hot air balloon, generally flying for about an hour with a full experience lasting about three hours. Other services include tethered flights, glow/static displays, banner advertising, partial inflation displays, candlestick fire displays, flight training, and educational talks. Flights carry up to five passengers with a combined weight limit of 1,000 pounds, depending on weather.
extraNote: No payment required before flight; payment accepted day of flight by cash, check, or Venmo · Flights depend on weather and safety; no guarantee of specific date
